name: M4 — Settings & admin screens: one markup, no desktop/mobile duplication
description:
MILESTONE M4 (blocked: needs M1 + strategy decision).
Vertical slice: "the administration screens stop duplicating themselves and work on a phone".

SCOPE
- Remove the content duplication in src/views/GlobalSettings.vue: today it renders a desktop aside plus a mobile drawer that repeats the same 10 v-if branches. Collapse into one markup that reflows.
- Same pass for Project settings, Account and the remaining settings/admin screens identified in the audit (per-screen consistency section).
- One saving pattern: the destructive/save actions are reachable without scrolling on a phone (sticky footer), and the unsaved-changes state is visible.
- Delete orphan components confirmed unused by the audit.

OUT OF SCOPE
Knowledge indexing internals, Infra/Docker panels, Analytics dashboards (separate increments if management wants them).

DEPLOYABLE + DEMOABLE
Demo: change a global setting, save it, reload, and show the same change from a phone.

ACCEPTANCE
- No duplicated content block between desktop and mobile in the migrated screens (single markup, responsive classes).
- Every settings screen is operable at 375 px without horizontal scroll.
- Save/reload round-trip demonstrated.
